finding: Representation Accessibility Finding: Linear probes achieve high accuracy on held-out dev probes: Relation Probe: 99.5% (chance: 10.0%), Language Probe: 100.0% (chance: 33.3%), Abstention Probe: 93.5%. This proves that high-level relation, language, and task structure are linearly separable in the internal representations at the generation boundary, yet standard autoregressive decoding does not translate this into entity outputs.
